responsibility: Implements the tree-SSA alias oracle for GIMPLE memory references and memory-walking queries. It answers whether statements may clobber or use a given reference, whether two ao_ref/reference trees may alias, and whether pointer dereferences can touch globals, using alias sets, TBAA access paths, component/offset overlap tests, points-to and mod/ref information, and call clobber/use summaries; it also maintains alias-query statistics and comparison/hash support for ao_ref-based memoization.
same_name_distinction: This source file implements the tree-SSA alias oracle itself, including ao_ref analysis, alias/disambiguation queries, virtual-operand walkers, and alias-query statistics. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-alias.h, which only publishes types such as pt_solution and ao_ref plus declarations for the query API and points-to interface, this file contains the executable alias-analysis logic.
